normative_extracts.quote: requestAnimationFrame schedules a callback to run immediately before the browser performs the next repaint for the active document.
The callback frequency generally matches the display refresh rate (60Hz, 120Hz) and pauses automatically in background tabs.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Limits high-frequency event reactions: debounce waits for quietness (network search), throttle caps fixed intervals, and rAF coalescing aligns DOM writes to display VSync.

production_failures.symptom: Typing in a search input feels laggy or drops characters when debounced incorrectly
production_failures.root_cause: Both the controlled <input> value and the API fetch were debounced together, delaying keystroke echo by 300ms.
production_failures.mitigation: Update the input state synchronously on every keystroke and debounce only the outbound network request.

production_failures.symptom: Drag-and-drop janks on 120Hz displays when throttled with setTimeout(..., 16)
production_failures.root_cause: Fixed 16ms setTimeout drifts out of phase with 8.3ms (120Hz) or 16.6ms (60Hz) VSync, causing double-updates in one frame and skipped updates in the next.
production_failures.mitigation: Use requestAnimationFrame coalescing (one pending rAF flag storing latest pointer coordinates) for all visual DOM updates.
